name: LongCat 2.0
title: LongCat 2.0: price, context window and specs
answer: LongCat 2.0 is a model from Meituan, first listed on 2026-07-20. It is the only version of its line in the catalog so far. It takes text in and returns text, with a context window of 1.0 million tokens and up to 262K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $0.3 per million input tokens and $1.2 per million output tokens. It supports a reasoning mode, where the model works through a problem before it answers. Its weights are published on Hugging Face as meituan-longcat/LongCat-2.0, so it can be run on your own hardware as well as through a provider.
